title: Perfect images of metrizable spaces
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
summary: Every continuous closed surjection with compact fibers from an arbitrary metrizable space has a metrizable codomain. A new uniform shrinking-star estimate for compact-fiber metric neighborhoods constructs a sigma locally finite open basis on the image. A proper-map formulation and an actual compatible metric are included. No second countability, separability, compact domain, local compactness, completeness, finite-fiber or nonemptiness assumption is made. Target separation is derived. Classical mathematics; no novelty or priority claim.

formalizes.title: Geometric Aspects of General Topology, second-edition author manuscript (November 2, 2023)

review.reason: Shows perfect images of metrizable spaces under compact-fiber maps remain metrizable, with proof.
